column1: # E11-T6 room background for wake test_neg: an hour, with the 22.9 public hours past the 24 the false-accept gate
# needs (KEHOACH 3.11). Two sessions since capture streams at most CONFIG_CAPTURE_DURATION_S (1860 s) a boot; record
# them last, at the product's pcm_shift, and leave the board alone. Columns as in levels.tsv.

column2: --kind noise --duration-s 1800 --prompt 'nền phòng 30 phút, không người nói, phần 1'
